claim: In Blood the only thing that clears a wall's blocking bits at run time is a kWallGib (type 511) XWALL reaching state 1: SetupGibWallState clears cstat 1|64 on both sides and the masked bit 16. A Z-motion sector moves floors and ceilings, never wall cstat, so a blocking two-sided wall that is not a gib wall is shut for ever. The bit is carried per side: a wall pair blocks if EITHER record has it; two sectors are cut apart only if every wall pair between them blocks.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/triggers.cpp:662-690 SetupGibWallState; no other wall-cstat write in vanilla Blood code clears bit 1 (gameutil.cpp:621 clears only 64; mapedit.cpp is the editor).
Campaign: 2,272 blocking two-sided walls, 205 of them kWallGib, every one built shut and wired (bloodmap/conditional.py blocking_aware base, 2026-09-01).
use: A breakable wall is a kWallGib XWALL built blocking; a reachability reader ORs both wall records and reopens only what a mechanism drives.
